# nam.edu

> > Nam.edu provides educational resources with enterprise-grade security infrastructure powered by Cloudflare.

Nam.edu is a educational institution website that leverages Cloudflare's security services to protect user communications and prevent bot abuse. The site implements email obfuscation and JavaScript-based protection mechanisms to safeguard visitor information.

## Key Topics

- Cloudflare
- Email Protection
- Bot Protection
- Email Obfuscation
- JavaScript Security
- Cloudflare Security
- Web Security

## Security & Protection

- [Email Protection](https://nam.edu/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection): Cloudflare email protection service for nam.edu with JavaScript-based obfuscation to prevent email harvesting and spam
